lines: Fresh linen, warm soup, and a bed that does not ask questions. That is my promise.
The inn rooms are being aired out for new arrivals.
If it fits in a chest, I can keep it safer than a pocket can.
Storage ledgers are still being stamped, so check back soon.
I trade in useful things, not shiny regrets.
The shop shelves are marked, but the till is not ready yet.
Ore sings if you heat it right. Most folks just hear clanging.
Bring me rough materials once the refining bench is set.
A good craft starts before the first stitch or strike.
My patterns are pinned up, but commissions are not open yet.
Hold still a moment. Even a small bruise tells a story.
Healing services will open once I finish sorting the herb jars.
Roads remember every boot. Mine remember plenty.
I will mark routes once the travel board is cleared.
Wanted notes, trail marks, claw counts. The board keeps all of it.
Hunter requests are posted here once the clerk stamps them.
Stay near the road if the grass starts moving against the wind.
